_: UI strings. The interactive pages share one codebase and are translated through this dictionary.
foot: Independent material. Items and notes written against the objectives each exam guide publishes, and verified against public documentation. They neither reproduce the live item bank nor the exam guides, and this project is not affiliated with Anthropic. Content under CC BY 4.0, code under MIT.
test_sub: Simulator for the Claude certifications · items written against the official blueprint
test_note:
Options are reshuffled every time an item appears, so position is never a clue and the same item looks different on each pass. Study in the notes first and use this to check yourself, not the other way round.

Original items written against the literal objectives of the Exam Guides v1.0 (Jul 2026) and verified against Anthropic's public documentation and the MCP specification. They do not come from the live exam bank and do not reproduce it. Where the official docs have moved on from the exam guide, the item says so.
no_data_short: No data yet. The real cut score is 720.
no_data: No data yet. The real cut score is 720 out of 1000.
verdict_comfort: Above the 720 cut score even at the low end of the range.
verdict_thin: Above the cut score, but the margin of error crosses it. Keep measuring before you book.
verdict_edge: Below the cut score, though within the margin of error. Don't book the exam yet.
stage_empty: Start a block. The drill and the 20-item mock give feedback at once; the full exam is marked at the end, on a clock, and lets you flag questions and go back. Progress is saved in this browser. A miss joins the review queue as soon as you make it and leaves after two correct answers two days apart.
queue_empty: Nothing in this queue. Try a weighted mock instead.
load_fail: This page needs to be served over http. If you opened it as a local file, run a static server in the site folder.
deck_fail:
Couldn't load the deck.
This page needs to be served over http, not opened as a local file.
nothing_due: Nothing due today. You can work ahead with a single topic.
tap_card: Tap the card to see the answer
fuera_d: These topics are not on your exam. They stay reachable because knowing what is not examinable saves time too, but they don't count towards your progress and never appear in a batch.
need_more: You have answered {n} of {min} distinct items, {pc}% correct. Below {min} the number would be noise, so nothing is projected yet.
basis: Based on {n} distinct items, counting only the latest attempt on each, and {cov}% of the blueprint. Approximate linear conversion: the real scale is not public.
confirm_finish: {n} questions are unanswered and will count as wrong. Finish the exam?
time_up: Time is up. The block was closed with what you had answered.
block_scaled: ≈ {s} out of 1000 on this block (approximate linear conversion)
none_answered: You did not answer any item in this block.
fail_waiting: No misses are ready for review. You have {n} waiting: you got them right once and they come back after two days to check it holds.
import_confirm: This replaces the progress saved in this browser with the one in the file. Continue?
import_bad: That file is not a Claude Certs progress backup.
bars_hint: Select a domain to practise it.
